claims.text: A landlord in Enugu cannot resort to self-help like lock-outs, removing roofs, or cutting power.
Unlawful eviction makes the landlord liable for damages in court, regardless of tenant status.
Under Enugu law, self-help like lock-outs or removing roofs is unlawful, and courts award damages against landlords who do it.
In Enugu, a landlord who changes locks or cuts off power is resorting to unlawful self-help.
Even if rent has run out, valid notice and a court order are required before any eviction.
Nigerian courts order landlords who use self-help to pay heavy damages to the tenant.
Landlords must follow the legal process and issue a proper Notice to Quit on time.

post.headline: What happens when an Enugu landlord changes your lock
lines: A tenant in Enugu came home to find his lock changed and electricity cut off because rent expired.
Many landlords think taking off doors or locking tenants out is a quick way to reclaim property.
In Enugu, a landlord cannot resort to self-help like lock-outs, removing roofs, or cutting power.
Unlawful eviction makes the landlord liable for damages in court, regardless of tenant status.
